[[File:Hoth_Chocolate.jpg|thumb|Hoth chocolate]]
'''Hoth chocolate''' was a variant of [[Hot chocolate/Legends|hot chocolate]] containing [[Tauntaun/Legends|Tauntaun]] [[Milk/Legends|milk]], and a number of different spices mixed with cocoa and boiling [[Water/Legends|water]]. Hoth chocolate was associated with the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]].
